$comment: HAND-MAINTAINED. What Higgsfield's own documents cannot say about its roster.
unmodel serves EVERY route in data/higgsfield/routes/ (owner decision, 2026-11-24): there is no allow-list,
and a route the next refresh adds is generated without anyone filing it here. This file holds the
exceptions, each with a reason, a source and the date it was verified:
handWritten        a route whose body is typed by hand, so the generator does not lower it
views.imageEdit    image routes the vendor files under `image_edit` that are NOT picture edits
excluded.routes    routes the documents list that unmodel deliberately does not serve
THE IMAGE-EDIT VIEW's RULE. An image route joins the view when its console document's "Category" lists
`image_edit`: that filing is the vendor's own statement that the route takes a source picture, and it is the
only published one. Where the route is also filed `text2image` (Ideogram 4.0, Grok Imagine Image 2.0, the
Marketing Studio routes) the picture is optional and the filing alone admits it; nobody re-reads each schema.
An entry under `views.imageEdit.exclude` is a person who did read one and found the picture is not the thing
ANTI-ROT: scripts/codegen-higgsfield.ts fails on any id here that the snapshot no longer lists, and on a
view exclusion naming a route the vendor no longer files under `image_edit`.
Not routes, and so not here: the console's playground presets (`workflows/*`). The refresh lists them in
manifest.json; each is a page over a model row, with no path of its own to POST to.

v1/custom-references.reason: Soul ID training creates a reusable character reference; it is not a generation route. It answers `{ id, status }` instead of the request envelope and is polled at GET /v1/custom-references/{id}. The console files it under the slug `soul-id` with the input schema `{"title":"Soul ID"}`, so only the docs page publishes its body, and the two sources cannot be reconciled pointer by pointer.
v1/custom-references.source: https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/soul-id/create-character.md ("This is not an image-generation endpoint; do not POST to /soul-id.") + https://dash.higgsfield.ai/models/soul-id/llms.txt

higgsfield/ai-influencer.reason: Filed under `image_edit, text2image`, but its optional `image_url` is an identity photo for a generated character sheet, not a picture being edited: the route has no `prompt`, and the page describes it as "Create one AI influencer character sheet." It stays an id at the wide image address.

higgsfiled/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0.reason: A misspelled legacy path (`higgsfiled`) for `higgsfield/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0`. It still answers, and the console's Genjutsu playground preset still points at it, but it has no console document (its llms.txt is 404) and no docs page; its page prints the older price sentence ("Each second of input video costs $0.318 at 480p …") beside the correctly spelled route's current one. unmodel serves the documented spelling only.
